what: The mathematician's window w6 (corpus/riemann/mathematician.md §7): the exact minimiser of κ₉ over even windows of degree 6, rounded to coefficients in (1/1000)·ℤ: v(s) = 1 − (157/500)s² − (3763/1000)s⁴ − (122/125)s⁶. From degree 6 on the exact optima agree to twelve digits (P* = 0.868641158957 at degrees 8, 10, 12, 16, 20), so this window carries the window method's constant for ξ′ at λ = 1 to within 3·10⁻¹¹. Same definitions and keys as xi-certificate.json (nine terms of D₁, the tail ε₉, J over the autocorrelation coefficients b_l, κ₉ = (∫v² + J)/(∫v)²); every number re-derived with exact fractions by tools/xi_window.py, 2026-10-22.
windowNote: the coefficients of v(s) in powers of s (degree 6, even), on [−1/2, 1/2]
vConvNote: the coefficients b_0..b_n of (v ⋆ v)(r) = ∫_{-1/2}^{1/2-r} v(t) v(t+r) dt for 0 ≤ r ≤ 1, by exact polynomial arithmetic; b_0 = ∫v² and Σ b_l = (v ⋆ v)(1) = 0
